_help: Manual tweaks on top of the wiki data. exclude: names to hide. aliases: extra accepted spellings. rename: change a displayed name. extra: halos not on the wiki yet (group = Playable, NPC or anything). For security, extra images must be a Blue Archive Wiki image link (static.wikia.nocookie.net) or a file uploaded to this repository, e.g. "halos/new-student.png".
